title: Ocean surveillance startup Quartermaster raises another $140M
summary: Quartermaster, an ocean surveillance startup, has raised an additional $140M to expand its real-time maritime monitoring technology, which addresses what the company describes as the largest surveillance gap on Earth.
content: The tech enables real-time awareness for what Quartermaster calls the “largest blind spot on Earth.”

zh.title: 海洋监视初创公司Quartermaster再融资1.4亿美元
zh.summary: 海洋监视初创公司Quartermaster再融资1.4亿美元，用于扩展其实时海事监测技术，该公司声称该技术解决了地球上最大的监测空白。

title: Philips’ motion-tracking smart toothbrush uses AI to make you a better brusher
summary: Philips has launched its AI-powered DiamondClean 9900 Prestige smart toothbrush with motion-tracking capabilities in Europe and the US at $379.99, undercutting competitors like Dyson while offering advanced dental monitoring features.
content:
First announced in July with an expected limited launch later this year, the Philips Sonicare Next-Generation DiamondClean 9900 Prestige smart toothbrush is now available in Europe and the US, with a broader global rollout expected in 2027. While the previous iteration is still available and discounted from $429.99, the new "Next-Gen DiamondClean" version is debuting for $379.99 even with its added capabilities. It doesn't floss for you, but it's cheaper than Dyson's $499 CameraJet smart toothbrush that some early adopters are having issues with.

zh.title: 飞利浦运动追踪智能牙刷使用AI助你成为更好的刷牙者
zh.summary: 飞利浦在欧美推出其AI驱动的DiamondClean 9900 Prestige智能牙刷，具有动作追踪功能，售价379.99美元，与Dyson等竞争对手相比价格更低，同时提供先进的牙齿监测功能。

title: SpaceX preps next-gen Starlink as Amazon’s competitor stalls
summary: SpaceX is preparing to deploy its first Starlink V3 satellites on a Starship flight today, marking a major constellation upgrade while Amazon's competing Leo satellite service faces delays and financial setbacks.
content:
SpaceX is gearing up for a monumental flight today that's sure to be closely watched by Amazon. If successful, SpaceX will deploy its first Starlink V3 satellites, which tout meaningful upgrades to the ever-expanding Starlink constellation. The 26 satellites will be riding atop Starship, which SpaceX will also attempt to deploy into Earth orbit for the first time. The mission arrives amid Amazon's ongoing setbacks with launch partners that are keeping its own Leo satellites grounded, and falling further behind its plan to offer a meaningful rival to Elon Musk's space internet service.

zh.summary: SpaceX准备在今天的Starship飞行中部署其首批Starlink V3卫星，标志着星座的重大升级，而亚马逊竞争的Leo卫星服务面临延迟和财务困难。

title: Microsoft goes quiet after church groups ask for 1% of data center costs
summary: Church groups have requested Microsoft contribute 1% of its data center costs as part of corporate responsibility efforts, but Microsoft has remained silent on the proposal despite claiming commitment to being a good neighbor.
content: “Microsoft claims to want to be a good neighbor, but the jury is still out."

zh.title: 教会团体要求微软贡献数据中心成本的1%后，微软保持沉默
zh.summary: 教会团体已要求微软将其数据中心成本的1%作为企业社会责任的一部分，但尽管微软声称致力于做一个好邻居，但对该提议保持沉默。

title: Honor’s Magic 9 Pro Max has a big camera and a bigger battery
summary: Honor has unveiled its Magic 9 Pro Max flagship smartphone in China, featuring an Arri-inspired camera system with cinematic capabilities and an exceptionally large battery, marking the company's first major flagship since partnering with the camera manufacturer.
content:
This mossy green looks great, but the 9 Pro Max is also launching in black and silver. | Image: Honor	

Honor launches its new Magic 9 flagship phones in China today, and the 9 Pro Max features a design revamp, a capable camera, and a colossal battery.
This is Honor's first flagship launch - Robot Phone aside - since it announced its collaboration with camera company Arri. The initial impact is twofold. The new camera island is Arri-inspired, drawing from the "three-lens turret" design first introduced in 1937's Arriflex 35, complete with a knurled texture around the main lens.

title: Truecaller takes its scam intelligence to the open web as it looks beyond caller ID
summary: Truecaller is expanding beyond its traditional caller ID business by launching its scam detection capabilities on the open web, as the company adapts to declining demand for its core service in India, its largest market.
content: Truecaller finds a new way to reach users as pressure grows on its traditional caller ID business in India, its biggest market.

zh.title: Truecaller将欺诈检测扩展到开放网络，超越来电显示功能
zh.summary: Truecaller通过在开放网络上推出其欺诈检测功能来扩展其传统来电显示业务，因为该公司正适应其最大市场印度对其核心服务需求的下降。
